default.$description: Primary typeface for the entire UI. Apply to all text elements unless a specific exception is documented.

micro.$description: Smallest text size (micro). Use for timestamps, footnotes, legal text, and metadata that is secondary to the main content.

label.$description: Label text size. Use for form labels, input helper text, tags, badges, and short UI labels inside controls.

sm.$description: Small display text size. Use for minor headings, section titles, card titles, and subheadings.

md.$description: Medium display text size. Use for page-level section headings and modal titles.

lg.$description: Large display text size. Use for primary page headings and prominent feature titles.

xl.$description: Extra large display text size. Use for hero headings and high-impact marketing titles.

2xl.$description: Double extra large display text size. Use for large hero sections and major landing page headlines.

3xl.$description: Triple extra large display text size. Largest available size — use for full-screen hero text or splash screens only.

sm.$description: Small body text size. Use for secondary body copy, compact lists, and supporting content in dense layouts.

md.$description: Large body text size. Default for primary body copy, descriptions, and paragraph content.

micro.$description: Line height for micro text. Tight leading for small labels and metadata where vertical space is limited.

label.$description: Line height for label text. Compact leading for UI labels, tags, and control text.

sm.$description: Line height for small display headings. Slightly tighter leading appropriate for heading sizes.

md.$description: Line height for medium display headings. Tight leading for mid-size headings to maintain visual density.

lg.$description: Line height for large display headings. Tight leading for large headings — prevents excessive whitespace between lines.

xl.$description: Line height for extra large display text. Very tight leading for hero-scale headings.

2xl.$description: Line height for 2XL display text. Near-1:1 leading for very large display headings.

3xl.$description: Line height for 3XL display text. Minimal leading for the largest text sizes — lines sit very close together.

sm.$description: Line height for small body text. Comfortable reading rhythm for secondary body copy.

md.$description: Line height for large body text. Optimal reading rhythm for primary paragraph content.

regular.$description: Regular font weight (400). Default weight for body text, descriptions, and secondary content.

medium.$description: Medium font weight (500). Use for labels, interactive element text, navigation items, and UI controls.

semibold.$description: Semibold font weight (600). Use for headings, section titles, and content that needs strong visual emphasis.

tight.$description: Tighter letter spacing applied to medium and semibold UI labels to counteract optical spread at smaller sizes.

normal.$description: Default letter spacing for body text and most content — no tracking adjustment needed.

wide.$description: Reserved for future use on uppercase labels or small caps — currently matches normal tracking, not yet differentiated.

display.$description: Tighter letter spacing applied to large display headings to improve visual cohesion at large sizes.
